issues.description: Existing extraction contains many non-target cell types (TASC, basal/intermediate/secretory/ciliated epithelial cells, AT2, fibroblasts, smooth muscle, endothelium, immune cells). All are excluded because the task scope is limited to Schwann cells and pulmonary neuroendocrine cells.
The paper identifies neuroendocrine (NE) cells but provides no gene-level markers in the accessible text or figure legends; no formal pulmonary neuroendocrine marker is included.
CD8 and SAA are not uniquely resolvable gene symbols; both are in non-target cell contexts and are recorded as non_gene_entity/ambiguous rather than resolved to specific genes.

task.paper_title: A Unique Cellular Organization of Human Distal Airways and Its Disarray in Chronic Obstructive Pulmonary Disease.
